comparison.interpretation: A single native text operation can prove character provenance from its exact native map, unchanged path/ancestor metadata and marks, unchanged sibling identities and exact resulting text. Scoped local diagnostics, not adoption gates. Normalization, history/storage growth, compaction and migration remain. No default switch, version/limit increase or publication.
